a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to run the generator to 8 will most likely leave both of us dead after round 1. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough to save one of us right now. So I intend to take 4 this round instead of following our original plan, and I'm telling you before we act. If you take too, the split is random and we probably both fall short. Afterward I'll operate every remaining round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
